{{Quote|I&mdash;I killed them. I killed them all. They're dead, every single one of them. Not just the men. The women and the children, too.|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="AOCN">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
The '''Rrhr hunting band''' was a clan of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At some point in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], they had established a [[Unidentified Tusken village/Legends|village]] in the [[Valley of the Spirits]]. The same year, the clan members were [[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|massacred]] by the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], in retaliation for having captured and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] his [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|mother]] to [[Death/Legends|death]]. The sole survivor, [[KkH'Oar'Rrhr]], vowed to take his revenge on Skywalker. The site of the massacre remained untouched for the next three decades.

==History==
{{Quote|They're like animals! And I slaughtered them like animals! I hate them!|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="AOCN" />}}
The Rrhr hunting band was a tribal clan of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], the nomadic people of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Blog" /> Like all Tusken Raiders, the Rrhr clansmen were nomads. They rove the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] for most of the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and established semi-permanent encampment during the hot season, setting up their [[Urtya/Legends|urtya]] [[Tent/Legends|tents]] in the barren wastes. While some tribes wore [[sand-repelling capsule]]s around the neck, the Rrhr only sported scarves. They also had spitters integrated into their masks so they could sprinkle their enemies with streams of [[Blood/Legends|blood]] during an attack.<ref name="AOTCV" />

[[File:Anakin_slays_tusken.jpg|thumb|left|A "Demon Outlander" massacred the clan.]]
One [[Standard month/Legends|month]] prior to the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Rrhr had settled a [[Unidentified Tusken village/Legends|village]]<ref name="AOCN" /> in the [[Valley of the Spirits]],<ref name="Insider 62">{{InsiderCite|62|Inside Attack of the Clones|Inside ''Attack of the Clones''}}</ref> an area of the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]]<ref name="AOTCV" /> that was considered a Tusken hunting territory. Around that time, they captured [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker Lars]], one of the planet's many [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists, while she was picking up [[Vaporator mushroom/Legends|vaporator mushrooms]] on her way [[Lars homestead/Legends|home]]. Skywalker Lars's son [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who was a tormented [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Apprentice]], tracked the Rrhr and found their camp, hoping to rescue his [[Parent/Legends|mother]]. However, she died in his arms,drawing the young man in a whirlwind of sorrow and hate. In retaliation, Skywalker stormed out of the tent in which he had found his mother and [[Death/Legends|killed]] every member of the Rrhr hunting band, even the women and the [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]].<ref name="AOCN" /> All were [[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|massacred]], save the young [[KkH'Oar'Rrhr]], who owed his survival to having been away bonding with his [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] that night.<ref name="Blog" />

Following that incident, KkH'Oar'Rrhr was adopted into [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett's]] clan, and Skywalker gained the name of "[[Demon/Legends|Demon]] Outlander" among the Tuskens. Retroactively, the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] of the Rrhr, Shmi Skywalker, was also deemed a [[Witch/Legends|witch]] and the mate of the demonic [[Great Jawenko]]. For his part, KkH'Oar'Rrhr vowed to avenge his family, embarking on a quest that ultimately led him to [[Shumari]].<ref name="Blog" /> The village itself was kept in its desolate form to honor the Rrhr Tuskens that had perished there, and its ruins could still be seen by [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>
